# host-walk-defs.txt: the name of every definition the parts of form-stdlib/bml/host-walk.bml hold, one per line.
# form-stdlib/tests/host-walk-band.bml (claim "split") reads the definitions of the aggregator's parts and holds only when each name
# below is held by a part and no name is held twice. It pins names, not bytes: a definition the local lane edits or adds changes no row
# here (the walk's behaviour is held by the other claims of the band). A definition dropped or renamed is "gone" in the band's output
# ("[host-walk-band] split: gone <name>") until its row is edited in the same commit.
